files.name: motion-prompt-104.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Blue hour" (ブルーアワー), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #104

What it is: The time after sunset or before sunrise when the sky turns deep blue
What the sample shows: Once the sun has set, the sky turns two bands of deep blue, the windows and street lamp come on in amber and the person becomes a dark blue shape.
Spec:
- Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). 
- Sun: radius 18 px at x 120, sinking from y 40 to y 190 while the effect reaches 70%, fading out between 40% and 80%
- Colour: sky #2C3B5E at the top and #4A6191 near the horizon, ground #283452, buildings #34446B, figure #1C2439
- Lights: one window in three and the lamp bulb turn #FFC75A; flat rings of 13 px and 8 px (#FFE3A3 at 35% and 60%) around the bulb
- Top-right time 12:00 → 18:35
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: For city and night scenes that need both a blue sky and glowing lights.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/104.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
